name: broadn
title: broadn.io
shortDescription: broadn streamlines manufacturing sales operations by automating the quoting and order processes directly from the inbox to the ERP system. It is designed for manufacturing teams that handle sales through email, particularly in sectors like electronics, automotive, and industrial components. An example use case is an automotive supplier using broadn to reduce manual errors and speed up order processing.
pros: Integrates with major platforms like SAP and Salesforce
cons: May require customization for specific needs
